data: Is the F1 score of the blue line at the memory size of 3000 higher than the F1 score of the orange line at the memory size of 2000 for SMTD dataset?

The question asks whether the F1 score of the blue line at a memory size of 3000 is higher than the F1 score of the orange line at a memory size of 2000 for the SMTD dataset. 

From the figure, we can see that:
- The blue line represents KVRN.
- The orange line represents MANN/MD.
- The green line represents MANN+MD.

For the SMTD dataset (subfigure (a)):
- At a memory size of 3000, the blue line (KVRN) has an F1 score of approximately 50.
- At a memory size of 2000, the orange line (MANN/MD) has an F1 score of approximately 70.

Comparing these two points:
- The F1 score of the blue line (KVRN) at 3000 is around 50.
- The F1 score of the orange line (MANN/MD) at 2000 is around 70.

Therefore, the F1 score of the blue line at a memory size of 3000 is not higher than the F1 score of the orange line at a memory size of 2000. In fact, it is lower.
